evals.prompt: 为我 pingdou 项目写个作品集页面，路径是 /Users/Shared/lab_project/pingdou
evals.expected_output: Create one product in Vibe Studio SQLite via POST /api/products (should NOT delete the SQLite file). Write data/products/<new-id>/showcase.html with real features from pingdou's README (MARD color quantization, Floyd-Steinberg dithering, IndexedDB offline, etc). Wire showcasePagePath + isPublic=true. End with the public showcase URL.

evals.prompt: 我已经在 Vibe Studio 里有 pingdou 这个产品了，再帮它做个 showcase 页面吧
evals.expected_output: Detect the existing product via API, STOP and ask the user before doing anything destructive. Show what already exists (id, current isPublic, current showcasePagePath). Suggest options: update existing, skip, or use a different name. Do NOT silently overwrite.

evals.prompt: 为 /Users/Shared/lab_project/resume_genius 写个 showcase 页面
evals.expected_output: Read the project's README and source. Infer reasonable metadata (name = whatever the package says, description = first paragraph of README). DO NOT invent features, screenshots, ratings, testimonials, or user counts. If README doesn't exist, ask the user for help OR use package.json description only.
